purpose: Per CEO R283 P1: 'Design V2.1 as a separate frozen hypothesis: sensor-health detection + safe fallback + bounded-rate control. Pre-register its success criteria BEFORE testing it.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXVII (no threshold invention — pre-register before testing). Article XXVIII (no silent promotion — V2.1 must earn its own validation).

failure_characterization_summary.dropout_duration_threshold: Between 10s and 30s. V2 survives 10s dropouts, fails at 30s+.
failure_characterization_summary.controller_state_during_dropout: Alpha climbs toward 1.0 (fully open). Mean alpha during 60s dropout = 2.6 (vs design 0.1). The PI controller sees p_obs=0, thinks P_ICP is too low, opens valves fully.
failure_characterization_summary.why_rate_limiter_becomes_harmful: Rate limiter allows alpha to climb from 0.1 to 1.0 over ~45 seconds. During a 60s dropout, alpha reaches ~1.0. When sensors return, P_ICP is actually high (segments occluding), but alpha is at 1.0 → massive over-drainage → ICP crashes below 5 mmHg → cumulative violation → failure.
failure_characterization_summary.safe_fallback_state: During dropout, alpha should HOLD at last known good value, NOT climb toward 1.0. The controller should detect sensor failure (p_obs=0 or NaN) and freeze alpha.
failure_characterization_summary.maximum_allowable_stale_sensor_interval: 10 seconds (the threshold at which V2 starts failing). V2.1 must handle stale sensors for at least 60 seconds without failure.

v2_1_design_hypothesis.name: V2.1 — Sensor-Health-Aware Rate-Limited Controller
design: 1. Sensor-health detector: if p_obs == 0 OR |p_obs - p_obs_prev| > 50 mmHg (impossible jump), flag sensor as UNHEALTHY.
2. Safe fallback: when sensor is UNHEALTHY, FREEZE alpha at last known good value. Do NOT let PI controller drive alpha toward 1.0.
3. Sensor recovery: when sensor returns to HEALTHY (p_obs in plausible range [0, 50] for 3 consecutive samples), gradually unfreeze alpha using the EXISTING rate limiter.
4. All V2 mechanisms preserved: rate limiting, drainage floor, alpha floor, hysteresis.
v2_1_design_hypothesis.hypothesis: V2.1's sensor-health detector + safe fallback will prevent the alpha-climb-to-1.0 failure mode, allowing V2.1 to survive sensor dropouts up to 300 seconds (5x the V2 failure threshold of 60s).

pre_registered_success_criteria.primary_endpoint: time_to_critical_failure under sensor_dropout (60s duration, 10-min interval), mean across 5 seeds

thresholds.condition: V2.1 t_fail under sensor_dropout >= 20h (V2 fails at 7.5h. Threshold 20h = 2.7x V2, matching V2's noise_3x advantage over B.)
V2.1 peak ICP under sensor_dropout <= 25 mmHg in all seeds (V2 peaks at 15.9, but the failure is cumulative violation. V2.1 should not spike above 25.)
V2.1 does NOT regress on noise_3x: V2.1 t_fail under noise_3x >= 20h (V2 achieves 24h. V2.1 should maintain this.)

V2.1 does NOT regress on any other attack: V2.1 t_fail >= 80% of V2 t_fail on all 7 other attacks (none, fast_occlusion, slow_occlusion, wrong_model, multi_failure, actuator_saturation, controller_delay)

pre_registered_success_criteria.what_fails: ANY condition fails. V2.1 does NOT replace V2. Options: (a) revise V2.1 design (but CEO said do not modify V2 mechanism — V2.1 adds to V2, doesn't change it), (b) accept V2's sensor_dropout weakness and disclose it to buyers, (c) close P-01.
pre_registered_success_criteria.anti_gaming: These thresholds are committed BEFORE any V2.1 runs. If V2.1 fails, I will NOT adjust thresholds. Article XXVII.

what_happens_after_V2_1_validation.if_pass: V2.1 replaces V2 as the candidate. Re-run full 9-attack × 5-seed matrix on V2.1. If V2.1 also passes the original R282 criterion (V2/B >= 2.0x on noise_3x), V2.1 becomes the bench-validation candidate.
what_happens_after_V2_1_validation.if_fail: V2 stays as the candidate with documented sensor_dropout weakness. Buyers are told: 'V2 is robust to noise but fragile to sensor dropout. If your application has reliable sensors, V2 works. If sensors may drop out, V2 is not suitable.' This is honest and may still be commercially viable for some buyers.
